title: Layout
description: vertical = 288 px column with each judgement's share of the notes; horizontal = one strip about 80 px tall for the top or bottom edge of the screen.

title: Position anchor
description: Corner of the source the panel hugs; place the source so this corner sits where you want the panel.

title: Show MAX:300 ratio
description: MAX (320) judgements per 300, to two decimals. Shows ∞ until the first 300.

title: Show keys per second
description: Live presses in the last second and the attempt's peak, counted from vosu's keys.all. Results and song select keep the peak of the attempt you just played.
